notes: STACK MEL01 (9-acre Truganina site, City of Wyndham): MEL01A (36MW, 226,000 sq ft) launched 2023; MEL01B (36MW, 226,000 sq ft, three-storey, 12 data halls) construction completed per DCD (26 Nov 2025, contractor Erilyan); MEL01C and MEL01D each 54MW planned; campus totals 180MW at full build-out. STACK entered Australia in 2022 taking over three Hickory projects - this campus subsumes the first-round 'Hickory Data Centres Truganina hyperscale facility (72MW)' record. capacity_mw=72 reflects built/completed phases; ultimate 180MW noted.
